# DemoPilot demo-script format reference

This file is generated from `packages/core/src/schema.ts`. It always matches the
schema the renderer validates against. Use it as the authoritative field list;
see `../SKILL.md` for guidance and `../templates/` for copy-paste starters.

## Top-level script

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | ✓ | Human-readable demo name |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `baseUrl` | string | ✓ | Base URL the demo runs against |
| `viewport` | object |  |  |
| `storageStatePath` | string |  | Path to a Playwright storageState JSON for pre-authenticated demos |
| `defaults` | object |  |  |
| `steps` | array of object | ✓ |  |

`viewport` shape (default `{ width: 1280, height: 800 }`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | integer (0–∞) | ✓ |  |
| `height` | integer (0–∞) | ✓ |  |

## Steps

`steps` is a non-empty array. Each step is an object with **exactly one** action
key (one-key shorthand). The available step kinds:

### `goto`

Path (joined to baseUrl) or absolute URL

Value: string

### `click`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | object | ✓ |  |
| `button` | enum: `left` \| `right` \| `middle` |  |  |
| `clickCount` | integer (0–∞) |  |  |

### `type`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | object | ✓ |  |
| `text` | string | ✓ |  |
| `cadence` | enum: `human` \| `fast` \| `instant` |  |  |

### `press`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keys` | string | ✓ |  |

### `hover`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | object | ✓ |  |

### `scroll`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | object |  |  |
| `to` | enum: `top` \| `bottom` |  |  |
| `by` | number |  | Pixels to scroll (positive = down) |

### `waitFor`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | object |  |  |
| `ms` | integer (0–∞) |  |  |

### `select`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | object | ✓ |  |
| `value` | string |  |  |
| `label` | string |  |  |

### `pause`

Milliseconds to pause

Value: integer (0–∞)

### `narrate`

Caption / narration line for this moment

Value: string

### `zoom`

Authored zoom region: 'in' forces a sustained zoom that holds until 'out'

Value: enum: `in` | `out`

### `group`

Authored action group: '{ name: … }' opens a group the camera holds one anchor across; 'end' closes it

Value: object | literal `"end"`


## Targets

Several steps take a `target` that identifies an element. Prefer accessibility
(`role` + `name`) — it survives markup churn far better than CSS. `css` and
`testId` are escape hatches. **A target needs at least one of: `role`, `name`,
`text`, `css`, `testId`.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `role` | string |  | ARIA role, e.g. button, textbox, link |
| `name` | string |  | Accessible name (label/text) of the element |
| `text` | string |  | Visible text content to match |
| `css` | string |  | CSS selector escape hatch |
| `testId` | string |  | data-testid value |
| `exact` | boolean |  | Match name/text exactly rather than substring |
| `nth` | integer (0–∞) |  | Disambiguate when several match |

## Defaults

All optional; omit the `defaults:` block entirely to run on DemoPilot's calibrated
defaults.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `typeCadence` | enum: `human` \| `fast` \| `instant` |  | `"human"` |  |
| `mousePace` | enum: `natural` \| `fast` \| `instant` |  | `"natural"` |  |
| `readPause` | integer (0–∞) |  | `850` |  |
| `preActionDwell` | integer (0–∞) |  | `450` |  |
| `postActionHold` | integer (0–∞) |  | `700` |  |
| `speed` | number (0–∞) |  | `1` |  |
| `zoom` | object |  | `{}` |  |

### `defaults.zoom` (post-production camera)

Applied by the compositor, not playback. The camera holds one anchor across each
action group, then springs/pans to the next; depth is chosen automatically from
the acted-on element's size.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | number (1–2) |  | `1.25` | Fallback zoom magnification (1 = none); superseded by min/maxZoom |
| `clickBoost` | number (0–1) |  |  | Deprecated — per-click punch removed; clicks stay anchored to their group |
| `minZoom` | number (1–3) |  | `1.15` | Shallowest adaptive zoom |
| `maxZoom` | number (1–3) |  | `1.55` | Deepest adaptive zoom |
| `fill` | number (0.2–1) |  | `0.62` | Target frame fill for a group |
| `establishLevel` | number (1–2) |  | `1.06` | Magnification during a far-jump establishing handoff |
| `panThreshold` | number (0–1) |  | `0.42` | Anchor distance (fraction of diagonal) above which a jump zooms out |
| `stiffness` | number (1–40) |  | `8` | Camera spring frequency (rad/s) |
| `damping` | number (0.4–2) |  | `0.92` | Camera spring damping ratio |
| `groupGapMs` | integer (0–∞) |  | `1800` | Max gap (ms) for adjacent actions to merge into one group |
| `cursorScale` | number (1–3) |  | `1.5` | Cursor magnification |
